text: Kenji's housewarming is Saturday 7 November 2026. Remind me to pick up a plant the day before, he said the new flat has zero greenery.
Esther lives in Leith now, works at the uni library. Two kids, both at primary.
so rory invited us to his 40th, it's at the cricket club on the 14th, and leah's doing the cake apparently. i said we'd come
Mei and Yuki are hosting a dinner on 2 November 2026 to celebrate their anniversary. Bring wine. Ask Mei the next day how the souffle turned out, she's terrified of it collapsing.
Jen mentioned her mum moved back to Cork last year. Lives near her sister now.
Eva's leaving drinks got cancelled, the new job start was pushed to March 2027 so she's staying on till then.
Colm - works nights at the depot, lives with his brother Oisín out past Swords. Doesn't drink. Big into hurling.

Need to text Barbara that evening to say thanks for having us. Lovely dinner, she'd done a whole roast for eight and still insisted on doing the washing up herself. Colm was in great form, telling the story about the caravan in Lahinch again. Their granddaughter Isla was there too, she's just started at the art college and is clearly loving it.
Anya's engagement party, 21 Nov. Don't forget to get a card a week before so it doesn't turn into a last-minute garage job again.

Isla said her dad's retiring at the end of the month after thirty-one years at the port authority, and there's a do at the golf club afterwards. She's dreading the speech he'll make, apparently he's written eleven pages. Her mum's planning a trip to Portugal for them both in March 2027 as a retirement present. Should get him a card the week before.
Paolo Rossi, Caroline's husband. Architect, works for the council. They're in the house by the canal.
Errands: collect dry cleaning, return library books, order the birthday balloons for Saturday.
Aaliyah's having people round for Diwali on Sunday. I'm doing the samosas. Her brother Ahmed's back from Dubai for it.
Henrik invited me to his band's gig at the Workman's on Friday. He's nervous, first one with the new drummer. Remind me to message him good luck that morning.
Bao works in IT at the hospital, lives in Dundee with his partner Keisha and their dog Pixel.
um so callum just rang, jess's surprise party is moved to the eighth now not the first, and he needs someone to keep her out of the house that afternoon, said I'd do it
Dinner at Jun and Irina's last night was brilliant. Irina's pregnant, due in March 2027! Should send them something nice next week.
Graham - Ruby's uncle - lives in Inverness, retired teacher. Ruby stays with him summers.
Emil's birthday drinks Thursday. He keeps going on about wanting a decent coffee grinder, hint hint.
Ayesha's mum's 70th is 12 December 2026, big family lunch in Bradford. Ayesha's stressed about organising it all. Check in with her the week before.
Vera and Alana are throwing a joint housewarming on the 31st, Halloween theme. Costume needed. I'm going as a pumpkin, obviously.
Remind me to ring Kenji the day after the party to see if the neighbours complained.
Esther's daughter Ruby starts big school in September 2027, they're looking at the one round the corner from Esther's work.
Leah got the job at the bakery!! She starts on the 3rd. Drinks at hers the Friday after to celebrate.
Mrs Moreau next door invited me for tea Sunday. Her cat Biscuit has had to have a tooth out, she's a bit upset about it.
Caroline - lives in Galway, works as a midwife. Husband Paolo, two teenage boys. Met at uni.
Must book the restaurant for Rory and Leah's anniversary dinner, we said we'd organise it for them. 15 January 2027 so plenty of time but still.
note to self: book flights for christmas before prices go up
Yuki said Kenji's sister Mei is moving to Osaka in spring. Leaving party probably in February 2027, she'll confirm afterwards.
Had coffee with Isla. She's been struggling since the breakup, not sleeping much. I should take her out for dinner sometime next week, somewhere quiet.
Barbara's 60th was a triumph. Need to send her the photos from the night, and print the one with her grandkids for the frame.
Jen's housewarming: Sat 28 Nov, from 7. Flat 3B, Albert Road. She's vegan so bring something she can eat. Text her the day before to check if she needs chairs.
Uncle Graham's funeral is next Thursday. Ruby asked if I'd come. Of course. Remind me to call her that evening, she'll be wrecked.
Callum (Cal to everyone) works for Okafor & Sons, the builders. Lives in Clontarf with his girlfriend Jess. Supports Bohs.
Paolo's cooking for the whole street at the summer party, 2026 one was cancelled because of the rain so he's determined this time. June 2027 probably.
Colm and his wife Barbara celebrating their 25th on 4 April 2027, small dinner, family only. Bit of a hint she'd love a weekend in Kerry, might chip in with the others.

Bao asked if I'd be at Keisha's book launch on the 19th. Said yes. It's her first novel, took her six years, and she's terrified nobody will turn up. Afterwards everyone's going for food at the Thai place on Camden Street. Remind me to buy a copy beforehand so she can sign it, and send her flowers the next day.
Eva's dad has Parkinson's, diagnosed last spring. Her mum does most of the caring. Eva's an only child and lives two hours away in Sligo.
Call the plumber Monday. Bathroom tap still dripping.

Voice memo: okay so, Henrik's fiftieth. It's the 9th of January 2027, he's booked out the upstairs of the Stag's Head, everyone dressing 1970s. His wife Vera's asked a few of us to do a slideshow, so I need to dig out the old photos from the Barcelona trip by Christmas. And remind me to pick up the frame the week before. Vera says he wants nothing, but he's been eyeing up those vinyl reissues of Abba for months.
Ahmed's son graduated yesterday, first in the family to finish uni. Must send congrats tonight.
Anya's in finance at a bank in Canary Wharf. Commutes in from Walthamstow. Hates the job, wants to retrain as a nurse eventually.
Keisha's dinner party Friday, 8pm. She's making that lamb thing again. Bring dessert.
Text Jess the morning after her party to check she's not too hungover to make Sunday lunch lol

Irina said her parents are flying in from Kyiv for the baby, staying three weeks. Her dad's never been to Ireland. She's anxious about having them in the flat, it's only two bedrooms and Jun works from home. They're thinking of renting somewhere nearby for the first week. I offered our spare room if it comes to it, which I meant.

Oisín's band split up, so the gig on Saturday's off. He seemed fine about it honestly, already talking about starting something new with his cousin Rory. He's working at the record shop on Capel Street four days a week and living with Colm still. Said he might do an open mic in January 2027 just to keep his hand in.
Lunch with Aaliyah. She mentioned Ahmed and his wife have just moved to Leeds, into a house near Roundhay Park. Her mum lives in Bradford still.
Kenji = works at Wang Engineering, graphic design side. Partner Yuki is a nurse. They live on Mount Street. Cat called Miso.
Ruby's choir is singing at the cathedral 13 December 2026 - she's got a solo and she's petrified. Message her the day before and then ring her afterwards.
Party this weekend at Rory's, he's calling it a 'garden thing' but knowing him it'll go till 3am. Leah says don't bring anything. Bringing something anyway.
Jun's mum is in hospital for her hip op on Tuesday. He's going over that morning. I should check in with him Wednesday.

Graham Andersson from work invited the whole team to his wedding next August, 2027. Big do in Sweden, on an island near his fiancée Vera's family's summer house. Save the date apparently coming in January. Need to sort annual leave the minute it lands, and probably start saving now because flights to Stockholm in August are not cheap.
Emil lives with his gran in Ranelagh, she's 94. He looks after her mostly. Works from home as a translator.

Talked to Mei for ages last night. Her brother Kenji's fine, back at work after the surgery, though still not allowed to lift anything. She's working at a nursery now, loves it, wants to do the teaching course next year. Her boyfriend Henrik is from Malmö and they're going over to meet his family on 18 December 2026, the day after her last shift. She's nervous about it.
Isla's sister Alana is expecting twins, due early 2027. Baby shower 6 December 2026 at Isla's. Remind me to get a gift the week before and ask Isla afterwards if Alana needs anything.
Callum said he'd pass on the invite to Jess's mum.
Barbara works three days at the chemist in Rathmines. Her husband Colm's a postman. Daughter Esther lives in London, son lives in Cork.

dinner at Paolo and Caroline's: amazing. Caroline mentioned she's got a big interview for head of midwifery on Thursday, she sounded nervous. Wish her luck Wednesday evening. Paolo's doing a pottery class now, very into it.

Long chat with Esther on the phone tonight. Her mum Barbara had a fall last week, nothing broken but she's shaken and Esther's flying home from London on 30 October 2026 to stay with her for a fortnight. Esther's own birthday falls while she's over, the 5th, so maybe a dinner the day after with the old crowd? Need to message Jen and Leah about it. Also Esther's started a new job at a publisher in Islington, she seems happy, finally out of the agency.

Weekend recap for myself because I'll forget otherwise. Friday was Ayesha's housewarming in Chorlton, lovely place, she's finally got a garden. Her partner Emil did a barbecue in the rain. Saturday was Jen's birthday brunch, she turned 35 and her boyfriend proposed at the table! Everyone in tears. Sunday I did nothing. Next up: Jen wants an engagement party in May 2027, and I should send her a card this week. And Ayesha mentioned her brother's starting at Manchester uni next September, so ask about that the next time we meet.
